Attribute.description: Representation of an attribute to be used to qualify a promotion

isoCurrencyCode.description: The currency code used for money calculations when determining discounts

tags.description: Tags to be used to find assigned promotions.

effectiveDateToUse.description: The date to use for the promotion calculations.  If left blank the current date will be used for the calculation.

basketItems.description: The list of items that promotions will be run against

categoryId.description: Category that was rewarded.  These categories are configurable, but common examples are: GIFT, SHIPPING, POINTS, POINTS_MULTIPLIER

reward.description: The value of the earned reward category.  Can take on different meanings based on the earnedCategory and earnedType.   For example, if earnedType is PCT, then this would be the percentage

includedIds.description: If the category is something item related (like GIFT), then this is the list of possible ids that can be rewarded as the gift

excludedIds.description: If the category is something item related (like GIFT), then this is the list of ids that should be excluded

promotionId.description: The promotion id that earned the reward
